about: Every tunable of np-bench. `default` is used by `np-bench run`, `check` by `np-bench check` (omitted: same as default). The CLI (--set exp.key=value), a --config file and the dashboard's run panel all read this file; scripts receive each value as NP_<EXPERIMENT>_<KEY>.

global.label: Quiet machine gate
global.help: Each measurement waits until the machine is at least this idle (0 skips the wait). Waits at most 10 minutes, then aborts rather than measure noise.

global.label: Pinned cores
global.help: Pin the server and the load generator each to this many cores (two machines only).

experiments.title: Preflight
experiments.blurb: Tools, native library, load generator, ssh, platform match.

experiments.title: Memory proofs
experiments.blurb: One-shot whole-process scans for planted secret values, client and server.

experiments.title: Throughput and latency
experiments.blurb: Closed loop: the most each server delivers, per configuration; configurations alternate each round.

params.label: Rounds
params.help: Odd rounds run configurations in order, even rounds in reverse.

params.label: Configurations
params.help: Space-separated subset; empty runs all: engine engine_java raw_netty raw_tomcat (plain HTTP baselines, no Spring), spring_nativepath spring_netty (plain HTTP), np_tls netty_jdk_tls netty_openssl_tls (HTTPS).

experiments.title: Stress ramp
experiments.blurb: Open loop: offers fractions of the peak rate and reports the knee.

params.label: Connections
params.help: The listen backlog is 128; more cannot all connect at once.

params.label: Configurations
params.default: engine raw_netty raw_tomcat spring_nativepath spring_nativepath_tuned spring_nativepath_shed spring_netty
params.help: Subset of: engine engine_java raw_netty raw_tomcat spring_nativepath spring_nativepath_tuned spring_nativepath_shed spring_netty.

params.label: p99 limit
params.help: The knee is the highest step served in full with p99 under this limit.

experiments.title: Soak
experiments.blurb: A steady load for a long time while the server host is sampled; memory scans at intervals.

params.label: Load
params.help: Open-loop rate as a share of the closed-loop peak measured first.

params.label: Memory scan every
params.help: 0 disables the scans.

params.label: Leak limit
params.help: Resident memory growing faster than this over the last hour fails the soak.

experiments.title: Scan under load
experiments.blurb: Planted secrets are sent while the server is busy, then the process is scanned; also after error, timeout and cancel paths.

params.label: Background load connections
params.help: 0 scans an idle server.

params.label: Cycles
params.help: Every scenario is repeated this many times.

params.label: Scenarios
params.help: Subset of: control secure error abort timeout.

experiments.title: Correctness under load
experiments.blurb: Every response is checked against what its route must return.

params.label: Servers
params.help: nativepath, netty or both.

experiments.title: HTTP clients
experiments.blurb: The Java HTTP clients against one server: java.net.http, RestClient on the JDK, RestClient on NativePath, the NativePath client. CPU and heap per request are the client JVM's.

params.label: Rounds
params.help: Even rounds run the clients in reverse order.

params.label: Clients
params.help: Subset of: jdk rest_jdk rest_nativepath nativepath.

experiments.title: Lane settings
experiments.blurb: The engine's lane tuning (batch, spin, work stealing) against its defaults, with and without Java workers, at 16, 64 and 256 connections.

params.label: Rounds
params.help: Odd rounds run configurations in order, even rounds in reverse.

params.label: Configurations
params.default: engine engine+batch4 engine+spin1 engine+steal engine+batch4+spin1 engine_java engine_java+batch4 engine_java+spin1 engine_java+steal engine_java+batch4+spin1
params.help: A server (engine, engine_java) plus settings joined by +: batch<N>, spin<N>, steal.

experiments.title: Capacity and break
experiments.blurb: How many virtual users each server sustains on a small fixed box within a latency and error SLA, and what happens past that.

params.label: Servers
params.help: Subset of: engine_java raw_netty raw_tomcat spring_nativepath spring_netty.

params.label: Seconds per level
params.help: A level only counts when it holds for this long, after the users have arrived.

params.label: Think time (ms, min-max)
params.help: Each user pauses this long between requests.

params.label: Ramp-up (s)
params.help: Users arrive over this time.

params.label: SLA: errors below (%)
params.help: 503s count as errors.

params.label: Server cores
params.help: The server is pinned to this many cores.

params.label: Server memory limit (MB)
params.help: Checked against the process's resident size at each level; JVM heaps are half of it.

params.label: Break phase
params.help: Past the limit: overload levels, then back to the passing level to see whether the server recovers.

params.label: NativePath connection limit
params.help: Raised from the default of 10,000 so the limit measured is capacity. Tomcat and Netty keep their own.

params.label: Workload mix
params.help: METHOD /path [body bytes or @file] weight; separated by ;

experiments.title: Database under load
experiments.blurb: The same SQL through the same pool, pgjdbc against NativePath. Needs Docker.

params.label: Drivers
params.help: pgjdbc, nativepath or both.

params.label: Scenarios
params.help: Subset of: select_pk insert rows10000 batch1000.
